title: A Letter to a Younger Reader
excerpt: A short essay written for anyone who still finds their way to books first.
content: Books have a unique way of opening doors that we didn't even know existed. Reading creates an inner room where imagination can breathe freely.
To every young reader picking up their first novel: trust the journey of the story.

title: On Silence and Sentences
excerpt: An essay on the pauses between words, and what they are asked to carry.
content: In fiction, what remains unsaid is often as potent as the dialogue on the page.
